BEGIN_PGML Last month, a full tank of gas for a car you drive cost you [`\$40.00\text{.}`] You hear on the news that gas prices have risen by [`12\%\text{.}`] By how much, in dollars, has the cost of a full tank gone up?
A full tank of gas now costs [_]{$cost}{10} more than it did last month.
END_PGML
########## # Solution ##########
BEGIN_PGML_SOLUTION Let [`x`] represent the amount of increase. We can set up and solve the equation:
[``` \begin{aligned} \pinover{0.12}{12\%}\pinover{\cdot}{of}\pinover{40}{old\ cost}\amp\pinover{=}{is}\pinover{x}{how\ much}\\ 4.8\amp=x \end{aligned} ```]
A full tank now costs [`\$4.80`] more than it did last month.
END_PGML_SOLUTION
